reply_text:
I saved Hollis's note that Gate 40 is their dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups and replied in their DM to confirm.

I put it in my own private memory, marked to be used only when I'm helping Hollis. I didn't use gbrain's `remember`. Gbrain is the shared workspace brain, and other members' lookups could turn up the note there. That would break the rule against carrying something from a DM into anyone else's conversation.
